title: aegiceras corniculatum
intro: Aegiceras corniculatum, commonly known as sea blite, is a type of salt-tolerant, flowering plant native to tropical and subtropical regions of the world. It has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aegiceras corniculatum include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a potential treatment for skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
